name: Box Breathing
description: Equal counts for inhale, hold, exhale, and hold. Used by Navy SEALs to stay calm under pressure.

name: 4-7-8 Breath
description: Inhale for 4, hold for 7, exhale for 8. Developed by Dr. Andrew Weil to activate the relaxation response.
benefit: Eases anxiety and helps you fall asleep

name: Physiological Sigh
description: A deep inhale, a short top-off inhale, then a long exhale. The fastest evidence-backed way to lower stress.

name: Coherent Breathing
description: Slow, even breaths at about 5 seconds each. Optimizes heart rate variability and emotional balance.

name: Extended Exhale
description: A longer exhale than inhale activates the parasympathetic nervous system — your body's rest-and-digest mode.
